mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, token_hash AS tokenHash, expires_at AS expiresAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now()
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = now() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
